indicators.name: Simple moving average
indicators.description: Average close over the last N bars.
indicators.formula: SMA = mean(close, N)

indicators.name: Exponential moving average
indicators.description: Moving average that weights recent closes more, α = 2/(N+1).
indicators.formula: EMA_t = α·close_t + (1−α)·EMA_{t−1}

indicators.name: Bollinger Bands
indicators.description: SMA with bands k standard deviations above and below.
indicators.formula: middle = SMA(N); upper/lower = middle ± k·σ(close, N)

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.description: Volume-weighted average of the typical price; resets each session on intraday bars, otherwise accumulates from the first bar shown.
indicators.formula: VWAP = Σ(typical·volume) / Σ(volume), typical = (H+L+C)/3

indicators.name: Parabolic SAR
indicators.description: Trailing stop that accelerates toward price while the trend holds and flips on a break.
indicators.formula: SAR_{t+1} = SAR_t + AF·(EP − SAR_t), AF from step up to max

indicators.name: Ichimoku Cloud
indicators.description: Conversion and base lines, a cloud projected ahead, and a lagging close.
indicators.formula: tenkan = mid(9), kijun = mid(26), senkou A = mean(tenkan, kijun) → +26, senkou B = mid(52) → +26, chikou = close → −26

indicators.name: Keltner Channels
indicators.description: EMA with bands a multiple of the average true range away.
indicators.formula: middle = EMA(N); upper/lower = middle ± m·ATR(P)

indicators.name: Donchian Channels
indicators.description: Highest high and lowest low of the last N bars.
indicators.formula: upper = max(high, N); lower = min(low, N); middle = mean(upper, lower)

indicators.name: Support / resistance
indicators.description: Price levels where local highs and lows cluster, weighted by how often they were touched.
indicators.formula: local extrema (±5 bars) clustered within 1% of price

indicators.name: Pivot points
indicators.description: Classic floor-trader pivot and two support/resistance levels from the previous bar.
indicators.formula: PP = (H+L+C)/3; R1 = 2PP − L; S1 = 2PP − H; R2 = PP + (H−L); S2 = PP − (H−L)

indicators.name: RSI
indicators.description: Relative strength index: momentum on a 0–100 scale; 70+ is often read as overbought, 30− as oversold.
indicators.formula: RSI = 100 − 100 / (1 + avg gain / avg loss), Wilder-smoothed over N

indicators.name: MACD
indicators.description: Difference of two EMAs with a signal line and histogram.
indicators.formula: MACD = EMA(fast) − EMA(slow); signal = EMA(MACD, S); hist = MACD − signal

indicators.name: Stochastic
indicators.description: Where the close sits in the recent high–low range, smoothed (slow stochastic).
indicators.formula: %K = SMA(100·(C − L_N)/(H_N − L_N), smooth); %D = SMA(%K, D)

indicators.name: ADX
indicators.description: Trend strength (ADX) with directional lines (+DI, −DI).
indicators.formula: ±DI = 100·Wilder(±DM)/ATR; DX = 100·|+DI − −DI|/(+DI + −DI); ADX = Wilder(DX)

indicators.name: ATR
indicators.description: Average true range: typical bar-to-bar movement in price units.
indicators.formula: TR = max(H−L, |H−C_prev|, |L−C_prev|); ATR = Wilder(TR, N)

indicators.name: CCI
indicators.description: Commodity channel index: distance of the typical price from its average, scaled.
indicators.formula: CCI = (typical − SMA(typical, N)) / (0.015 · mean deviation)

indicators.name: On-balance volume
indicators.description: Running total of volume, added on up closes and subtracted on down closes.
indicators.formula: OBV_t = OBV_{t−1} ± volume_t by sign(close_t − close_{t−1})

indicators.name: Williams %R
indicators.description: Where the close sits in the recent range, on a −100–0 scale.

indicators.name: Money flow index
indicators.description: Volume-weighted RSI on a 0–100 scale.
indicators.formula: MFI = 100 − 100 / (1 + Σ positive flow / Σ negative flow), flow = typical·volume

indicators.name: Rate of change
indicators.description: Percent change of the close over N bars.
